name: sp_170_Normalized

schema.description: Context Schema for a Roku video event (reflects the Video node: https://developer.roku.com/en-gb/docs/references/scenegraph/media-playback-nodes/video.md)

contentId.description: ID of video provided in content metadata.

contentTitle.description: Title of video provided in content metadata.

contentType.description: Category of video (e.g., movie, season, series) provided in content metadata.

contentUrl.description: URL of video provided in content metadata.

errorStr.description: A diagnostic message indicating a video play error. Refer to the Roku Video documentation for the format of the string.

height.description: Height of the video play window in pixels. 0 if the play window is set to the height of the entire display screen.

isResumed.description: Indicates whether the playback was resumed after trickplay.

isUnderrun.description: Indicates whether the stream was downloaded due to an underrun.

measuredBitrate.description: Measured bitrate (bps) of the network when the stream was selected.

streamFormat.description: Container format of video (e.g., mp4, wma, mkv) provided in content metadata.

timeToStartStreaming.description: Time in seconds from playback being started until the video actually began playing.

videoFormat.description: Video codec of the currently playing video stream (e.g., hevc, mpeg2, mpeg4_15).

videoId.description: ID generated when video tracking of the video node was initialized.

width.description: Width of the video play window in pixels. 0 if the play window is set to the width of the entire display screen.

instructions: Could you remove the streamUrl field, please?
